text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in still frames by using depth maps to guide upscaling, which directly improves visual clarity without adding motion artifacts. The trade-off is a slight increase in compute time per frame, but the quality gain outweighs the cost for high-stakes outputs.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasted effort: we’d burn cycles on a tool that doesn’t address the core problem. Instead, test VFI-Flow’s motion reconstruction first; if it cuts blur by 0.5%+, it’s the better lever. Settle it with a side-by-side A/B on 100 frames: blur metrics don’t lie.
